verdict.rationale: Column is fundamentally an API-first banking platform: its docs describe a comprehensive, public REST API (OpenAPI spec confirmed live via probe) covering accounts, transfers, wires, ACH, cards, webhooks, reporting, and sandbox testing, with idempotency keys and API key modes for programmatic control. Community corroboration confirms it's HTTP-API-driven (SDKs optional) and praises the documentation quality. missing for 10: no independent third-party audit of API completeness beyond one HN thread, and no official client SDKs (customers use raw HTTP/OpenAPI-generated clients instead).
